baseline_reconciliation.note: The store score counts every star rating; the sample counts only written reviews, and people with a bad trip are more likely to write one, so the sample mean is lower.

methodology_disclosures.multi_label_overlap: Theme categories are non-mutually-exclusive (multi-label). Individual reviews can express multiple friction points simultaneously (e.g. tracking glitch AND late pickup). Therefore, theme citation counts overlap, and category percentages of negative reviews sum to more than 100% (specifically 262.14% of negative reviews).
methodology_disclosures.negative_share_sample_bound: The 29.61% negative review rate represents the proportion of 1-2 star reviews within this 8,000 collected written review dataset. It should not be conflated with the entire 1.5M+ daily rider population, as dissatisfied riders have a significantly higher propensity to write text reviews than satisfied riders.

theme_breakdown.label: General Dissatisfaction
theme_breakdown.description: Generic negative sentiment and frustration without a specific technical feature specified.

theme_breakdown.label: App Crashes & Performance
theme_breakdown.description: App crashing, freezing, blank screens, loading failures, or update breaking the app.

theme_breakdown.label: GPS & Live Tracking Glitches
theme_breakdown.description: Inaccurate ETA, map auto-zooming out, vehicle marker frozen, route mismatch, or location delay.

theme_breakdown.label: Booking & Roster Flow
theme_breakdown.description: Self-booking failures, confusion between login/logout shift timings, slot cutoff, waitlist issues.

theme_breakdown.label: Pickup Delays & Cab No-Show
theme_breakdown.description: Late vehicle arrival, incorrect pickup window, excessive waiting time, or driver not reaching point.

theme_breakdown.label: Login, SSO & Session Expiry
theme_breakdown.description: Frequent automatic logouts, SSO sign-in failures, credentials rejected, or account locked.

theme_breakdown.label: Driver Conduct & Commute Safety
theme_breakdown.description: Rash driving, speeding, rude demeanor, refusal to turn on AC, unauthorized driver, safety concerns.

theme_breakdown.label: OTP & Notification Friction
theme_breakdown.description: Delayed OTP SMS, seatbelt modal blocking instant OTP retrieval, missing ride alerts, push notification spam.

theme_breakdown.label: Support Desk & Issue Resolution
theme_breakdown.description: Transport desk unresponsive, tickets closed without solution, lack of real-time support during incidents.

theme_breakdown.label: UI Usability & Forced Rating Prompts
theme_breakdown.description: Forced rating prompt with no skip button, confusing UI redesigns, clunky navigation.

theme_breakdown.label: Positive Commute Feedback
theme_breakdown.description: Praise for timely rides, safety, user-friendly interface, smooth office commute, or great driver.

app_performance_crash.text: The worst app I have ever seen. The app crashes frequently in first place. When try to make booking or update details it stops working and get closed by itself. After many attempts of reinstallation, still issue continues. When checking the vehicle location, it is not showing the correct location. In short, data, energy and time waste. Please fix. Being in market for long years is not so important, providing user friendly digital service and making the travel experience peaceful is much needed

The app frequently crashes or hangs while booking cabs, which makes it really frustrating, especially when I’m in a hurry. The GPS tracking is unreliable—it often shows the driver in the wrong location, causing unnecessary delays. Notifications are delayed or sometimes don’t come at all, so I end up missing important updates about my ride.

Then we have to reinstall the app and login again to make it work. Please take care of this quickly.
